scope: Direct ALSA USB playback to hardware playback/output meters; physical digital connectors and high-rate ADC paths unmeasured. Not automatic rate-aware validation in oscmix-desk.

method.playback: ALSA hw:CARD=II24216011,DEV=0; S24_3LE; resampling/channel/format conversion disabled; -40 dBFS, 997 Hz, one USB channel at a time for 0.5 s
method.capture: Concurrent direct ALSA stream establishes the selected mode; captured PCM discarded without saving; does not validate capture-channel content.
method.judgement: All requested channels must show ordered -40 dBFS playback peaks with duration 0.3..0.7 s. Ten sides of the five known stereo routes must match simultaneous source plus output-fader gain within 0.5 dB; opposite side below -110 dBFS.
method.timing: Use central source peak plateau, removing first 100 ms and last 180 ms; source and output peak-hold reports can be displaced by one 100 ms interval. Require at least two reports for driven and opposite outputs. This avoids counting the next channel at the boundary.
method.instrumentation_limit: Four timed-out 16/20-channel Quad-Speed attempts retain ALSA hw_params, stream frequency and meters, but the OSC refresh was not copied into the result before the timeout. during_messages/clock_report_hz are null for these attempts, not backfilled from the requested rate.
method.restoration: Every case returns to 48 kHz/20 USB channels, reapplies the known desk and compares all 2,252 complete readable messages. Playback matrix is not directly readable.

cases.method:
One explicit ALSA mode, low-level channel scan, then return to 48 kHz.

Direct hardware PCM avoids PipeWire resampling. Capture bytes are discarded.
OSC meters qualify the USB playback map and configured analog mixer paths;
without external cables this does not qualify physical digital connectors.

OSC meters qualify the USB playback map and configured analog mixer paths;
without external cables this does not qualify physical digital connectors.

OSC meters qualify the USB playback map and configured analog mixer paths;
without external cables this does not qualify physical digital connectors.
